Padma Multipurpose Bridge

পদ্মা বহুমুখী সেতু

A two-level crossing connecting Mawa in Munshiganj with Jajira in Shariatpur.

Opened in 2022

About this place

The main span extends 6.15 kilometres. A highway uses the upper deck and the railway uses the lower deck. Replacing the need for a ferry crossing on this corridor has made Mawa part of a fixed road connection between Dhaka and the southwest. River-training works help manage erosion and flow around the approaches.

Use public viewpoints around Mawa for photography. The bridge roadway is a transport corridor.
